hyppothesis_tested: 251 observed readers produced 0 orders. One untested explanation was that product links in the Telegraph articles are plain text rather than clickable anchors, forcing readers to hand-copy a URL. If true, that would be a severe and invisible conversion defect.
hypothesis_result: REFUTED - and this was worth proving

evidence.conclusion: link clickability is NOT the blocker. 50 of 54 links are real anchors, including our own flagship. No repair needed on the 50.

REAL_DEFECT_FOUND_AND_ATTEMPTED_REPAIR.defect: 4 live articles carry the product URL as plain text, not a link. One of them (the highest-viewed of the four, 9 views) additionally points at a dead Gumroad slug /l/WSHDUE, which returns HTTP 404. The correct live product is /l/uucxer (HTTP 200).

articles.title: Multi-State Sales Tax Nexus: The Rolling-12-Month Method
Subscription Renewal Compliance: The Owner-Rule Audit
Food Truck Permits: The 5-Permit Stack Method

REAL_DEFECT_FOUND_AND_ATTEMPTED_REPAIR.root_cause: these 4 articles were created under a different/older Telegraph access token. getPage reads fine with the current token, but editPage rejects every write with CONTENT_FORMAT_INVALID - including a deliberately minimal one-line body, which proves the rejection is an ownership boundary and not a formatting problem with our HTML.
REAL_DEFECT_FOUND_AND_ATTEMPTED_REPAIR.safety_check_performed: a minimal destructive edit was attempted to isolate the cause and was expected to fail. It did fail. All 4 public pages were then re-fetched and confirmed byte-intact: 6/5/4/6 paragraphs and 729-885 words each, corrupted=False. No live content was damaged.
REAL_DEFECT_FOUND_AND_ATTEMPTED_REPAIR.no_blind_rewrite: the repair script refuses to substitute a slug it did not find; it skips rather than guessing, so no article could be silently rewritten to the wrong product.
REAL_DEFECT_FOUND_AND_ATTEMPTED_REPAIR.how_to_fix: open the 4 articles in a browser while signed into the Telegraph account that created them, wrap the product URL in a link, and change /l/WSHDUE to /l/uucxer in the nexus article. Estimated 3 minutes. Nothing else is required.
REAL_DEFECT_FOUND_AND_ATTEMPTED_REPAIR.status: BLOCKED - founder action required, small and well specified
